value.rationale: The dimer dynamics on the four-dimensional unit cube is the first small natural hypercube with frozen square-only states, so adding the smallest non-square alternating local moves is a mathematically motivated local-dynamics transition, not an arbitrary graph parameter. The sharp four-move bound with every source extremal and the complete geodesic distance census quantitatively resolve transformation efficiency at this minimally mobile threshold; these exact invariants are not implied by existing yes/no ergodicity or square-only results and are useful finite benchmarks for higher-dimensional dimer dynamics.
